notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
So it's been a while since our last update on the game. 
We have been busy working on Mara's Quest but, we also have full time jobs, school, and families too.
But, we have not given up on Mara's Quest. I just wanted to keep you in the loop of the many things we have been changing since the last update.
First thing I'd like to mention is we have been re-working the whole inventory, attack, enemy AI and abilities systems. 
With the new systems, You'll be able to dual wield single handed weapons and are able to select which weapon you would like to attack/counter attack with.

We have also been updating many of the art assets used in the game.
Here are a couple of examples.

notes.title: Early Access Version: 0.9.2.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Several enemy AI issues have been resolved. Enemies should now target and go after their best target.
[*] Console screen Max Health, Shield, Max Shield bugs fixed.
[*] AI debug enable button has been added to the console screen.
[*] The movement squares have been cleaned up.
[*] UI has been cleaned up a bit.
[*] Map creator grid and selection squares have been cleaned up.
[*] Console screen Max Health, Shield, Max Shield bugs fixed.
[*] Current time and current level timer added into game.
[*] Level 19 end dialog has been modified.
[*] Issue fixed with character icons being visible past the mask.
[*] Issue fixed with the dialog screens skipping first dialog entry.
[*] Issue fixed fixed needing to hit skip button to end dialog issue.
[/list]
